instruction: Change the reply position setting to place my replies below the quoted text instead of on top.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing reply position from top (1) to bottom (0). The evaluator checks if mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is set to 0. Original profile has reply_on_top=1, so this requires modification. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) where reply position setting is stored
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and matches mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top against expected value
Expected value is semantically correct: reply_on_top=0 means place replies below quoted text (vs reply_on_top=1 for above)
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (change reply position to below) and evaluator checks exactly this
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird to ensure settings are flushed to prefs.js file before reading
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly from get_rule, accesses rule.get('expect', {})
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file is None or if preference key is not found in file

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
